g.text: Weighted density per log10 earnings unit
A weighted distribution of positive annual earnings
Annual earnings among urban earners in Balochistan

Source: PSLM person and household data. Sample: ages 15–64, positive annual earnings, Balochistan (province code 4), urban (code 2). Household weights used. Histogram excludes 0 earners outside Rs 10,000–10,000,000.
